baslik_yt: Raw Carrots: Why Oil and Cooking Help Absorption
aciklama: In a lab digestion model, only 3 percent of the beta-carotene in raw carrot pieces was released. See how mashing, cooking and a little oil changed that, and why salad dressing matters.
